SSH to westd-16639, check nvidia-smi and process list to identify vLLM server processes on cuda:0, cuda:2, cuda:3 that have NO active experiment clients.

     --pw-data data/proofwriter_depth5_600.json \
     --output <found_results_path> \
     --resume > /tmp/qwen25_seed456_resume.log 2>&1 &
   ```

5. 确认进程启动，检查 log 前几行确认 resume 成功（应显示 "Resuming from X/600"）

- Blackwell GPU 需要 `VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0` 和 `--enforce-eager`
- 检查是否需要 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 设置（如 libnvrtc 路径）

2. 确认 Qwen2.5 seed456 恢复运行（PID、GPU、从哪个 progress 恢复）
